description.value: Canim Lake General Store is a rural convenience and general store serving the small community at Canim Lake in BC's Cariboo region, one of the more remote stretches of the interior plateau. For touring cyclists passing through this lightly serviced area, it represents a critical resupply point well off the main highway corridors. The combination of 'general store' identity and convenience-shop tagging suggests a broad range of everyday goods.
